+## What
+Create and change tasks. The basis is plan.md §4.2, §5.5, §6.1, and §3.3 rule 6.
+- `MutationResolvers.swift` (task part): `addTask(title!, body, column, ordinal, assignees, tags, dependsOn)` and `updateTask(id!, …)` (a list replaces the list as an `add`/`remove` difference; a missing field = no change; `null` = clear).

+- `body`: an `edit` patch with the diff; never the full text.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] `addTask` returns the new task with `id`, `shortId`, `ready`, and `blockedBy`.
+- [ ] Each mutation with `body` writes one `edit` patch with a diff, and a new task gets a diff from the empty text.
+- [ ] A dependency cycle is refused and nothing of that field is written.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsKanbanTests/Mutations/AddUpdateTaskTests.swift`: port the Rust add and update dispatch tests (field clear and no change, assignees, tags, dependencies, no partial write).
+- [ ] Run `swift test --filter AddUpdateTaskTests`; expect all pass.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.

+  text: |-
+    Research notes (implement step):
+    - Null vs missing: GraphQLSwift `valueFromAST` gives `.undefined` for a missing input field and `.null` for a literal `null`; `MapSerialization.object(with:)` drops `.undefined` keys and maps `.null` to `NSNull`. So a decoder sees a missing key as absent and `null` as a present nil. A shared tri-state `FieldUpdate<Value>` (unchanged / cleared / changed) can decode this with a `KeyedDecodingContainer.decode(FieldUpdate<V>.Type, forKey:)` overload that synthesized `Decodable` picks up.
+    - Graphiti `InputField(_:at:)` reads the key path only for the GraphQL type, so a computed `Value?` key path on the tri-state field gives the schema type. Graphiti `Wrapper` is internal, so the type cannot map itself.
+    - Mint: `ULIDSource.makeULID(avoiding:)` exists; the source lives in `WorkingCopy.stamp`. `CommitSession.run` keeps the source across runs, so a re-run after a changed log mints a new ULID.
+    - Two engines with the same `FixedULIDSource` mint the same task ULID in their first run; only the commit check keeps the second task out of the first task's file. This is the two-process test.
+    - The fixture of `KanbanGraphTests` has one column `todo` (terminal), so a test that needs a not-done dependency adds a second column first.
+    - The session actor of the fixture (`actor/claude-code`) is not in the fixture logs, so addTask with no assignee gives no assignee there.
+    - Cycle path text follows `CommitTests.ruleFailure`: short ids with `^`.
